review_candidates.title: Technology Director
review_candidates.description: Job Description General Responsibilities The Technology Director must plan, organise, direct and integrate the operations of technology systems and infrastructure that support the School in meeting its needs. This position provides leadership, expert professional assistance and internal consulting across departments on the design, development and implementation of technology solutions. This includes but is not limited to applications and technical infrastructure to meet short- and long-term mission and strategic objectives. Specific Responsibility The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to this class. Provides day-to-day leadership and works with staff to ensure a high-performance, service oriented work environment that supports the achievement of the department’s and School’s mission, objectives, and values; promotes workplace diversity, inclusion, cultural competency, and a positive work environment. With members of Senior Management, participates in the development and implementation of School strategic plans, goals, and objectives including Guided Pathways; leads and directs department staff in the development and application of new methodologies, technologies, and process improvements to achieve higher efficiency, productivity in department work processes. Leads manages and participates with other School directors and administrators in the School’s Information Governance processes intended to advise the HoS and leadership team on direction, strategy, policies, standards and priorities for technology solutions and systems; works with School managers to gain agreement on School-wide technology and architecture standards to ensure a cohesive, compatible and standard-based approach to delivery of application, network and systems infrastructure solutions throughout the School. works with School managers to develop and present recommendations on technology development and project priorities. Other Duties Stays abreast of information technology developments and evaluates their applicability for meeting School needs and requirements; maintains up-to-date technical knowledge in order to carry out assigned responsibilities effectively. Performs related duties as assigned. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES Knowledge Of Principles, best practices and techniques of information technology management, including SIS/CMS/LMS, student records and other applications. Trends, directional developments and best practices in information technology as they apply to formulating technology solutions to meet educational objectives, particularly in educational environments. Internet and intranet technologies and cloud-based technology solutions. Data management and network architectures and design and integration theory and principles. Technology security and vulnerability management principles, practices and related methodologies. Operating principles, parameters, methods, practices and limitations of server and network platforms. Principles and practices of data management, administration and storage solutions. Principles, methods and techniques of project management as applied to information technology projects. Skills And Abilities To Work collaboratively with School principals, directors, managers and the community and provide expert advice and counsel to develop solutions to complex issues on an enterprise-wide and division-specific basis. Define issues, analyze problems, evaluate alternatives and develop expert, independent conclusions and recommendations on complex technology issues in accordance with laws, regulations, rules and policies. Organize, set priorities and exercise expert, independent judgment within areas of responsibility. Develop and maintain an inclusive work environment that fosters diversity, respect and engagement. Job Requirements EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Any combination of experience and training that would likely provide the required knowledge and abilities is qualifying. A typical way to obtain the knowledge and abilities would be: Understanding of, and sensitivity to, the diverse academic, socio-economic, ethnic, religious, and cultural backgrounds, disability, and sexual orientation, of community college students, faculty and staff. Graduation from a four-year college or university with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, instructional technology or business administration; AND At least seven years of progressively responsible information technology experience in the design, development, implementation, operation and maintenance of a complex information technology program in a public or private sector organization, at least three years of which were in a management or supervisory capacity; OR An equivalent combination of training and experience. Desired Education And Experience Master & Degree in Information Systems, Technology Management, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration, or comparable field. Previous professional Information Technology supervisory experience with oversight of a discrete professional IT unit such as desktop/technical support, enterprise applications, network/systems administration, communications, or similar field. Experience in a school setting, educational institution or other public agency.

review_candidates.title: IT Project Manager
review_candidates.description: Position Overview The IT Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering cross‑functional IT Business Applications initiatives that support TAS’s rapid growth and operational scale‑up. This role serves as the execution owner for ERP, analytics, integration, and application projects—ensuring work is prioritized, coordinated, delivered on time, and adopted successfully by the business. This role sits within the System of Management (Project Management Office) pillar of the IT Applications organization and partners closely with ERP Analysts, Data & Analytics, Integration, and business stakeholders to convert priorities into reliable outcomes. Key Job Responsibilities Project Planning & Delivery Own end‑to‑end delivery of IT Business Applications projects, including ERP enhancements (Infor LN), analytics initiatives (Power BI / Fabric), integrations, and third‑party application implementations. Translate business priorities into clear project plans, timelines, dependencies, and milestones. Manage scope, risks, issues, and change requests to ensure predictable delivery and minimize disruption to operations. Cross‑Functional Coordination Coordinate work across IT teams (ERP, Data, Integration, consultants) and business functions (Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, etc.). Serve as the primary point of accountability for project execution—ensuring decisions are documented, owners are clear, and follow‑through happens. Partner with vendors, consultants, and system integrators to manage deliverables, timelines, and quality. Governance, Communication & Reporting Maintain structured project governance, including status reporting, risk tracking, dependency management, and escalation. Provide clear, concise updates to IT leadership and business stakeholders—focused on progress, risks, and next steps. Ensure projects meet defined success criteria and are transitioned cleanly into support and steady‑state operations. Testing, Deployment & Adoption Coordinate testing/UAT, release readiness, training readiness, and go‑live activities for application changes. Ensure documentation, job aids, and training materials are prepared in partnership with IT and business SMEs. Support post‑go‑live stabilization (“hyper care”) and confirm outcomes are realized. Portfolio & Intake Management Support intake, prioritization, and sequencing of IT requests in partnership with IT leadership. Help balance capacity, urgency, and business impact across concurrent initiatives. Contribute to improving repeatable delivery processes, templates, and standards across IT Applications. All other duties as assigned by TAS. Education & Training Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Preferred training/certifications in one or more areas: cloud data platforms, data engineering, analytics engineering, data governance, or AI fundamentals for data/analytics professionals. Minimum Requirements 5+ years of experience managing IT or business applications projects in a manufacturing, engineering, construction, or operations‑oriented environment. Proven experience delivering projects involving ERP systems, analytics/reporting platforms, and integrated application ecosystems. Strong ability to manage cross‑functional teams, competing priorities, and ambiguous requirements. Experience coordinating testing/UAT, deployments, and change adoption. Excellent communication skills—able to translate technical work into business‑relevant updates. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting Infor LN or other enterprise ERP platforms. Familiarity with Power BI, analytics initiatives, or data‑driven reporting projects. Experience working with third‑party vendors, consultants, and system integrators. Exposure to integration concepts (APIs, data flows, interface dependencies). Experience in high‑growth or transformation environments where governance and prioritization are critical. Physical Requirements/Work Environment Position is at least 80% to 95% at a desk working with computer. Ability to exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Performs other physical activities including use of fingers, sitting, stooping, bending, crouching, talking, hearing, and performing repetitive motions. Visual acuity requirements include color, depth perception and field of vision necessary to prepare and analyze data and figures, operate a computer terminal, and conduct extensive reading. The incumbent will be subject to inside environmental conditions. Company Overview Join a team driven to excel in all that we do! When you join TAS, you join a Houston-headquartered company that is part of a large Houston-headquartered publicly traded company, Comfort Systems USA, with a solid reputation built on outstanding value, integrity, and customer focus. We offer our customers and employees the best of both worlds: a small company feel with the resources, talent, process, and international reach of a large company. TAS delivers innovative packaged modular systems that are engineered and manufactured in one of our Houston, TX facilities and utilized in data centers, power, and commercial/industrial utility system applications. TAS has successfully delivered and commissioned over 520 packages to over 33 countries. The company is headquartered in Houston, TX and has five ISO 9001 certified manufacturing facilities in Houston, encompassing 1.2m sq. feet with proximity to major shipping ports and interstate highways. TAS manages all logistics and transportation facilitating accelerated construction at customer’s facilities. TAS’ fastest growing business is the data center market. By applying deep expertise in cooling, thermodynamics, and power, TAS has developed an entire product line that revolutionizes data center delivery. With our tremendous market potential, advanced technological systems, entrepreneurial culture as well as a talented and productive workforce, we continue to set and exceed aggressive market penetration and financial goals. More information is available on the company website at: www.tas.com. IMPORTANT NOTICE: TAS has a tobacco-free workplace policy, under which individuals are not allowed to smoke or use tobacco or nicotine products on the TAS premises, while conducting TAS business off premises or take "smoking" breaks during working hours. “smoking” and “tobacco or nicotine products” includes, but is not limited to, product such as cigarettes, e-cigarettes, cigars, pipes, vaping, all forms of smokeless tobacco (chewing tobacco, snuff, dip) and clove cigarettes The above declarations are not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job described, nor are they intended to be such a listing of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Rather, they are intended only to describe the general nature of the job. Applications and resumes will be kept on file for a limited time and the Company is under no duty or obligation to contact applicants if they are not selected for the job applied for or if other jobs become available in the future. Applicants that desire to apply for a job that becomes available at the Company in the future, should submit a new employment application or resume. TAS Energy Inc. guarantees equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment, without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

review_candidates.title: Director - Head of Corporate Credit IT, ISPL
review_candidates.description: Job Title: ISPL Head of Corporate Credit IT Department : Banking Platform IT About Business Line/Function Corporate Credits at BNP Paribas CIB is the bank’s dedicated platform for delivering large scale, customized financing solutions to corporates and institutions worldwide. It combines deep sector expertise, a robust risk framework, and a global syndication network to support M&A, project development, working capital needs, and other strategic financing objectives. Current strategic focus is on sustainable finance, digital transformation, and expanding in high growth regions while preserving credit quality and delivering strong, client centric results. Provides structured financing, revolving facilities, term loans, and syndications to large corporates, financial institutions, and public sector entities worldwide. Position Purpose As Delivery lead, Manage the Corporate Credit software delivery teams based in India to deliver expected IT functionality with stability & scalability. Managing a span of control of 100+ FTEs. Responsible for relationship management with Business, Operations & IT sponsors in conjunction with global domain leads. Lead transversal initiatives for the Banking Platform IT department beyond the domain, e.g. DevSecOps, Gen AI usage, Test Automation + Shift Left, Development methodology (Agile practices), Cloud native approach etc. By being a part of the ISPL Banking Platform IT Executive Committee: Contribute & strengthen the management vision of the department. Contribute to the continuous improvement of Banking Platform IT ISPL and implementation of best practices. Lead by example and disseminate the management values & objectives for Banking Platform IT Leadership group to boost Banking Platform IT ISPL performance. Contribute to initiatives/collaboration across all domains of Banking Platform IT. Responsibilities Direct Responsibilities Vision In Strategy Key leadership role responsible for managing and driving the IT strategy, execution and delivery of technology and solutions, for Banking Platform IT The successful candidate will ensure management of 100+ Corporate Credit IT professionals. Transform, evolve, recruit, upskill and develop people to have mission ready and top-notch team at Banking IT, India CoE for Corporate Credit. Will act as a key partner with business stakeholders to drive the overall Corporate Credit strategy. Must be very well versed with Corporate Credit business, its challenges and operational needs. Build strong relationship with global and regional Business, IT & Ops leaders, in collaboration with different IOCs, to drive business successfully and to ensure consistency and alignment across systems. Visualize business changes and create an IT/innovation mindset so that solutions are ready for the growth of business and are future ready. Delivery And Operations Overseeing delivery of high-quality, complex IT Programs for various products/instruments used by Credits business lines Implement Agile methodologies to ensure efficiency in delivery operations. Platform availability, scalability and performance – to support high transaction volumes. Collaborate with Application Production Support to optimize production incidents resolutions. Manage relationships with technology partners ensuring cost effective delivery of solutions. Leverage emerging technologies to enhance system architecture and solutions. Drive digital transformation initiatives to improve delivery efficiency. Budget management and cost optimization. Continuous monitoring of performance & efficiency of the setup. Identify opportunities for process and technologies improvement. Enable solutions and act as escalation point for Administrative & HR topics. Provide support for business stakeholders & operations leadership. Risk And Compliance Ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements. Drive all the dimensions of IT risk management for the full scope of Credit assets. Implement existing robust IT governance and reporting mechanisms to manage operational excellence. Risk mitigation via implementation of technology obsolescence remediation. Digital Transformation Manage initiatives, which includes framing transformation programs Design or transform IT assets with “Cloud Native” features. Getting buy-in from stakeholders and contributors Define the governance, secure capacity, and budget, build/consolidate and maintain the plan, manage dependencies and drive to completion, ensuring effective communication, continuous alignment of contributors and timely running of governance routines. People Development Evolve (recruit, upskill, develop) teams to be at next level and work efficiently with partners in Paris & Poland teams. Drive and manage people development initiatives in partnership with HR. Responsible for mentorship and career growth of the in-scope employees. Consulting point for Talent Acquisition & Technology solutions. Further develop architectural / design skills within leveraging on in-sourced out-sourced staff. Contributing Responsibilities Corporate Credit domain knowledge to effectively discuss and strategize client and operation’s needs. Should be able to drive functional discussions with non-technical stakeholders Technology validation & evolution. Support & leadership to organizational initiatives. Identify gaps in existing systems and create action-plans to plug those gaps rapidly. Promote automation in all areas that helps to improve quality and faster delivery. Technical & Behavioral Competencies Candidate must be very familiar with Corporate Credit processes and functions, and must be able to effectively and efficiently discuss with business counterparts Good knowledge of corporate banking products like Payments, Trade Finance, eBanking, Accounting systems is a big plus. Expert in various project development methodologies (Agile-Scrum, Agile-Kanban, Waterfall etc) In-depth understanding of tooling and engineering aspects of software development (DevOps Tools, Cloud technologies etc.) Must be able to collaborate with the development, test & production support team Good communication skills and excellent team player Proven experience of managing large delivery teams (100+ FTE) Active Interest and Experience in AI techniques applied to Delivery and Deployment procedure would be a plus. Behavioral Skills Skills Referential ( Required knowledge, skills and abilities) Ability to collaborate / Teamwork Organizational skills Communication skills - oral & written Creativity & Innovation / Problem solving Transversal Skills Ability to understand, explain and support change Ability to anticipate business / strategic evolution Ability to inspire others & generate people's commitment Ability to manage / facilitate a meeting, seminar, committee, training Ability to develop and leverage networks Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent Experience Level: At least 15 years Location: Bengaluru / Mumbai About BNP Paribas Group BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability. About BNP Paribas India Solutions Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. review_candidates.description: 1 Inventa Place Silver Spring, MD 20910 Kids Are Our Everything. You will serve as a subject matter expert, guiding cross-functional teams in the development of scalable, evidence-based solutions that enhance clinical efficiency and patient safety. You will mentor junior team members, lead complex projects, and ensure alignment with organizational goals, regulatory requirements, and industry standards. (Preferred) Doctor Of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) (Required) Required Skills/Knowledge Communication: Excellent presentation and communication skills, adept at conveying complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and translating clinical and operational requirements to technical audiences. Technical: Emerging expertise in health information technology and clinical informatics, including direct experience with electronic health records and digital health platforms. Familiarity with cross-venue clinical workflows and health care operations, including revenue cycle, analytics, and other business processes. Knowledge of quality improvement and process improvement methodologies and health information and health care regulations and laws. Proficient in user-centered design principles, human factors engineering, usability testing, and software development life cycle. Committed: Unwavering dedication to the vision for enterprise Information Services in service of our mission and core values. Collaborative: Strong team player with a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Innovative: Ability to think creatively and develop forward-thinking workflow solutions.
